ADDED AT FBV2-EXP-002 (D-238). PIN ORDER IS THE ECOSYSTEM STANDARD, NOT A CHOICE: 1 GND (black), 2 3.3 V (red), 3 SDA (blue), 4 SCL (yellow) - identical for SparkFun Qwiic and Adafruit STEMMA QT, so every cable in either ecosystem mates it. IT ADDS NO COMPONENT: it lands on the PROTECTED EXTERNAL segment at EXT_SDA / EXT_SCL, downstream of U16 TCA4307 and of the R47/R48 22 ohm series pair and at D2's TPD4E1B06 clamp, so it inherits the hot-swap buffer, the R49/R50 1.5 k pull-ups, the series resistance and the ESD array. POWER IS ACC_3V3_SW AND THAT IS ARCHITECTURAL, NOT A PREFERENCE: U16's own VCC is already ACC_3V3_SW and the pull-ups pull to it, so feeding the port from unswitched +3V3 would create a powered-device / unpowered-bus state and invite back-feeding through the accessory's ESD diodes. ACC_5V_SW IS NEVER EXPOSED HERE.
